get_init_fn: get an initialization function by style name like xavier, sonar, zero, trunc_normal, or kaiming_uniform
init_linear_to_sonar: initialize a linear layer weight and bias to match SONAR embedding variance distribution
init_linear_xavier: initialize a linear layer using Xavier uniform weight initialization and zero bias
init_linear_kaiming_uniform: initialize a linear layer using Kaiming uniform weight initialization with computed bias bounds
parse_activation_fn: parse a string name like gelu or relu into the corresponding torch.nn activation module
